name: Creation Austin
blurb: Austin stop of Creation's touring Supernatural reunion weekend, with cast autographs, photo ops, panels and a concert.

picks: House band on the Supernatural tour

editions.evidence: Official calendar page: 'Austin, TX Nov. 20-22, 2026 - Creation Austin'; event page: 'November 20-22, 2026 • Marriott Austin Downtown Hotel'.

notes: Same touring Supernatural-cast brand as Pittsburgh/Boston/DC/Salt Lake City. Unlike those pages, Austin's guest cards are single images (no thumbnail+full duplicate pair), each confirmed by filename (e.g. #19 is loudenSwain.jpg) and matching a WebFetch read of the live page in the same order. Refute pass (2026-10-05): upheld -- a fresh re-extract shows none of the 19 cards carry caption text (bare photos), and most headshots are old/reused stock images (e.g. jensenAckles-1.jpg, Jan 2025) hosted across Creation's OTHER 2026 tour-stop subdomains (ce-lasvegas26, spn-toronto, ce-vancouver26), which is why a staleness scan flagged them; that pattern reflects this operator's shared cross-city photo library, not a frozen page, confirmed by: (1) this roster is not a verbatim copy of the actually-confirmed Aug 22-24 2025 Austin edition -- it drops Jim Beaver, Alaina Huffman, Gil McKinney and Chad Lindberg and adds Julian Richings and Lisa Berry, so the card list itself has been edited for this edition even though several photo assets are evergreen reuses; (2) Rob Benedict's image filename is 'robBenedict2026.jpg' and Jake Abel's/Steve Carlson's were both freshly uploaded to this Austin site in July 2026, all three after the 2025 edition ended; (3) ticket sales for these Nov 20-22, 2026 dates are live (Gold/Silver weekend passes already sold out). No cancellations section or 'see you next year' banner found. Lower-confidence than radcon/galaxycon-richmond since no single piece of evidence covers all 19 by itself -- Julian Richings and Lisa Berry specifically rest only on roster-churn plus their photos being newer than the 2025 show, not a same-city filename/date tag.
